findings.summary: Nothing points a cautious saver to the safe track or compares it with a bank deposit.
Many safe-sounding tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so they can't be compared.
The large stock return (24.04%) is the first number seen, and the reader finds it frightening and misleading.
The dark background, thin text and dense table are tiring to read.
The exposure circles are too close in color and too small to tell apart.
Track names and column headers use jargon and English letters with no plain explanation.
The site name 'מקור' is unknown, and nothing shows the site is official.
The return column header doesn't say whether the 3-year figure is per year or total.
The list is long, with 15 screens to scroll.
